versos.e: 3. A priest commissioned to go through Israel and instruct the people in the law 2Ch 17:8
.Murders his brothers to strengthen himself in his sovereignty 2Ch 21:4,13
.The Philistines and Arabians invade his territory 2Ch 21:16,17
.Marries Athaliah, whose wicked counsels influence his reign for evil 2Ki 8:18,19; 2Ch 21:6-13
